calibration_sources: Sarathi-Serve (OSDI 2024): Taming Throughput-Latency Tradeoff in LLM Inference with Stall-Free Chunked Prefills
vLLM V1 & SGLang Zero-Overhead Asynchronous CPU-GPU Overlap Scheduler Architecture Benchmarks
Orca & DistServe / Llumnix SLO-Aware Admission Control & Preemption Thrashing Mitigation Studies

workload.cluster_node: 1 × 8×H100-80GB SXM5 Node (900 GB/s NVLink-4, $28.80/hr node cost)
workload.traffic_mix: Mixed Enterprise Traffic: 75% Interactive Chat (2K Prompt / 512 Out) + 25% Long-RAG Bursts (32K Prompt / 512 Out)
workload.slo_contract: Strict Dual SLO: P99 TTFT <= 1,500 ms AND P99 TPOT <= 45.0 ms (No Mid-Sentence Stutter)

tiers.name: Tier 1: 请求级静态批处理 Static Batching (短请求陪跑最长请求 + 补零浪费)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Request-Level Static Padded Batching (Head-of-Line EOS Blocking)
tiers.batching_policy: Locks batch until all 32 requests reach EOS; pads every prompt to max batch length
tiers.preemption_and_cpu_overlap: No preemption; synchronous CPU batch assembly between batches
tiers.recommended_for: Legacy offline batch scoring only; unusable for interactive LLM serving due to 4.25s queueing stalls and 42% padding waste.

tiers.name: Tier 2: Prefill 优先连续批处理 (vLLM v0 默认) + 重算抢占 (1,840ms 吐字卡顿雪崩)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Prefill-Prioritized Continuous Batching + Recomputation Preemption
tiers.batching_policy: Iteration-level batching, but incoming 32K Prefills preempt all active Decodes for 1.8s
tiers.preemption_and_cpu_overlap: Drops evicted KV Cache & recomputes from scratch on KV OOM (24.5% thrashing) + Sync 3.5ms CPU scheduler
tiers.recommended_for: Low-concurrency internal testing without long prompts; fails production P99 TPOT SLAs whenever a 32K RAG prompt arrives and freezes all active streaming users for 1.84 seconds.

tiers.name: Tier 3: Sarathi 零停顿分块预填充 (Chunked Prefill=2048 混跑 Decode) + 内存 Swap
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Sarathi Stall-Free Chunked Prefill (Token Budget=2048) + Host DRAM Swap
tiers.batching_policy: Splits 32K Prefill into 2,048-token chunks; piggybacks 64 active 1-token Decodes in the same forward pass
tiers.preemption_and_cpu_overlap: PCIe Pinned DRAM Swap on KV pressure (4.2% overhead) + Synchronous 2.8ms CPU scheduler

tiers.name: Tier 4: 零开销异步 CPU-GPU 重叠调度 (vLLM V1) + 85% 水位线准入 + SLO 动态分块
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Zero-Overhead Async CPU-GPU Overlap Scheduler + 85% KV Watermark + SLO Dynamic Chunking
tiers.batching_policy: Dynamically sizes Prefill chunks (512..4096) based on active Decode TPOT slack + SJF/EDF priority
tiers.preemption_and_cpu_overlap: CPU prepares Step t+1 while GPU runs Step t (0.1ms stall!) + 85% KV Watermark Gate prevents preemption (0.2%)
tiers.recommended_for: Production high-concurrency LLM serving clusters demanding zero mid-sentence stutter (28.5ms P99 TPOT) and 3.76x higher SLO-compliant goodput.
